overview: The Hollowshade Supply Road is the lifeline between Shar Vahl and the Hollowshade warfront.
history: The road was carved to support Vah Shir supply caravans.
Lookout posts were built to monitor tribal movements.
Ambush sites formed as Owlbears, Sonic Wolves, and Grimlings raided caravans.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, patrol frequency increased.
Scout commanders established emergency rally points along the road.
hooks: A caravan wagon breaks down mid‑route.
A scout lookout reports tribal movement.
An ambush site shows fresh tracks.
